overview: Law in India splits sharply into two ecosystems. The 5-year integrated BA LLB / BBA LLB at NLUs (via CLAT/AILET) is the gold standard — ~4,100 UG seats nationally, brutal competition for ~3% acceptance rate, and tier-1 firm salaries of ₹15-22 LPA for freshers. Outside the NLU pipeline, 3-year LLB (post-graduation) at Delhi Faculty of Law, GLC Mumbai, and tier-2/3 colleges produces another ~80,000 lawyers/year, most heading into litigation, judicial services, or in-house roles where pay starts low (₹3-6 LPA) but scales with niche expertise. The 2026 reality: M&A and corporate law dominate big-firm hiring, but IP law, tax law, sports/entertainment law, and international arbitration are smaller, faster-growing niches with disproportionate pay. Foreign law firms entering India (post-BCI 2023 rules) is reshaping the senior end of the market.
key_insights: NLSIU Bangalore, NALSAR Hyderabad, NLU Delhi (via AILET) are the only 'guaranteed tier-1 firm placement' law schools — the 'NLU' tag below the top 7 ranks is closer to a tier-2 private college outcome.
Tier-1 firm fresher A0 pay is now ₹15-22 LPA (CAM, Trilegal, Khaitan, AZB, SAM); IP-specialist firms pay much less (₹6-10 LPA fresh) but offer better work-life balance.
Judicial Services (state civil judge) entry pay (₹11-14 LPA) exceeds most non-NLU fresh-graduate firm offers and gives you a Group A judge post by age 26.
Company Secretary (CS) qualification overlaps significantly with Law — many Commerce students pursue CS-LLB combo for in-house corporate counsel roles paying ₹15-30 LPA mid-career.
International Arbitration is one of the highest-paying niches globally; SIAC Singapore, ICC Paris seats are accessible to Indian lawyers with 5-7 years experience and pay USD 1.5-3K/day.

sub_paths.name: 5-year Integrated BA LLB (NLU Route)
sub_paths.description: 5-year integrated law degree at National Law Universities — the standard top-tier law school path. Combines Arts + Law.
sub_paths.govt_fees: NLU Tiruchirappalli ~10 lakh total (lowest); avg NLU 12-25 lakh total
sub_paths.private_fees: Symbiosis Law Pune 12-18 lakh; OP Jindal Sonipat 25-40 lakh; private NLU equivalents 18-30 lakh
scholarships: NLSIU Trilegal, IDIA scholarships for SC/ST/disadvantaged
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: LLM at Harvard, Yale, Oxford, Cambridge, NYU (₹40-80 lakh) common after 1-3 years of work. Direct foreign firm hiring rare; NY Bar/UK Bar exam route common.
sub_paths.day_in_life: 5-yr program intense — moots, internships every winter/summer, journals, debates. Internships at law firms decide placement track from year 3.
sub_paths.growth_path: A0 (fresher associate) → A1 → A2 → SA1/SA2 → PA → Counsel → Partner. Tier-1 firm partner ₹1-5 Cr+. Or judicial services / academia / in-house counsel.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher (A0 tier-1): 15-22 LPA / Mid (SA1-2, 4-7 yr): 30-50 LPA / Senior (Partner, 12+ yr): 50 LPA-5 Cr+. Note: Tier-2 firms 8-15L fresher; tier-3/regional ~3-6L. Source: Legally India, Law Drishti 2025-26.

sub_paths.name: 5-year Integrated BBA LLB / BCom LLB
sub_paths.description: 5-year integrated business + law degree — corporate-law focused with business fundamentals. Strong fit for corporate/M&A path.
sub_paths.entry_route: Govt exam (CLAT / AILET / private univ tests)
sub_paths.entrance_exam: CLAT, AILET, SLAT (Symbiosis), LSAT India, MH-CET Law
sub_paths.govt_fees: 12-22 lakh total at NLUs (BBA LLB at TNNLU, RGNUL etc.)
top_institutions: NLSIU (govt, BA LLB main; BBA at some NLUs)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: LLM in Corporate Law/M&A/Finance at NYU, Stanford, Oxford. Strong pathway to in-house roles at MNCs in Singapore, Dubai.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Same NLU-style intensity but with business case studies, finance, accounting integrated. Better fit for corporate counsel pathways.
sub_paths.growth_path: Same A0-Partner ladder; or in-house counsel at MNCs/banks. CFO-track for Commerce + LLB combo possible.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 12-20 LPA (tier-1) / Mid: 25-45 LPA / Senior: 50 LPA-3 Cr+. Note: Same as BA LLB but tilted slightly more toward in-house corporate roles. Source: Legally India, Law Drishti.

sub_paths.name: 3-year LLB (Post-Graduate Route)
sub_paths.description: 3-year LLB after any Bachelor's degree — the traditional law degree. Strong choice for those entering law after 1st-time non-law UG.
sub_paths.entrance_exam: DU LLB Entrance, BHU UET, Delhi Univ Faculty of Law, MH-CET Law (3-yr)
sub_paths.govt_fees: Faculty of Law DU ~15,000-30,000 total; GLC Mumbai 5,000-15,000 total (govt = nearly free); BHU 50,000
sub_paths.private_fees: ILS Pune 1-2 lakh; Symbiosis 5-9 lakh; private deemed 6-12 lakh
top_institutions: Faculty of Law, University of Delhi (govt)
Banaras Hindu University Faculty of Law (govt)
Faculty of Law Aligarh Muslim University (govt)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Same LLM pathways as 5-yr LLB; treated as equivalent BCI-recognized degree.
sub_paths.day_in_life: 3-yr program is condensed — heavier theory load. Many students working part-time as articled clerks / paralegals during the degree.
sub_paths.growth_path: Litigation/junior counsel route (₹10K-30K/month start) → independent practice; or judicial services; or 3-yr LLB grads can also crack tier-2/3 firms with strong internship record.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 2-8 LPA (tier-2/3 firm or litigation) / Mid: 5-15 LPA / Senior (independent practice): 15 LPA-1 Cr+. Note: Litigation income highly variable; senior advocates at SC/HC ₹20K-1L per appearance. Source: Bar Council, Legally India.

sub_paths.name: LLM (Specialization)
sub_paths.description: Master of Laws — 1 or 2 year specialized degree (Corporate, IP, Tax, Constitutional, Criminal, International Law).
sub_paths.entrance_exam: CLAT PG (NLUs); AILET (NLU Delhi); LSAT India; university-specific
sub_paths.govt_fees: NLUs ₹1-3 lakh total; DU LLM ₹15K-30K; Indian Law Institute ₹1-2 lakh
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: LLM abroad — Harvard ($75K total), Yale, Oxford BCL, Cambridge, NYU, NUS Singapore. Funded LLMs (Inlaks, Felix, Commonwealth, Chevening) viable.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Coursework + thesis/dissertation. NLU LLMs heavy on academic writing; foreign LLMs also bar-exam (NY Bar, UK Bar) prep route.
sub_paths.growth_path: LLM is a credential signal — boosts academic, judicial, regulatory, and senior firm trajectories. Less direct salary impact than seniority.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresh post-LLM: 4-12 LPA / Mid: 12-30 LPA / Senior: 30-80 LPA. Note: LLM most useful for academic, regulatory, foreign-firm tracks; corporate firms care less about LLM than experience. Source: Law Drishti, Legally India.

sub_paths.name: Judicial Services (Civil Judge / Magistrate)
sub_paths.description: Direct entry to state-level lower judiciary as Civil Judge Junior Division or Judicial Magistrate. Group A post by age 25-26.
sub_paths.qualification: LLB (3-yr or 5-yr); enrollment with state Bar Council
sub_paths.duration: Exam cycle 8-12 months; judicial training 1 yr
sub_paths.entrance_exam: State Judicial Services Exam (DJSE Delhi, RJS Rajasthan, UPJS, MPCJ, BiJS, MHJS)
top_institutions: Judicial Academies in each state (govt training)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Mid-career LLM at Yale, Cambridge for sitting judges; Commonwealth Judicial exchanges; UK/US sabbaticals.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Court bench duties — hearing arguments, recording evidence, judgments, case management. Fixed 10-5 hours; case backlog heavy.
sub_paths.growth_path: Civil Judge JD → Sr Civil Judge → ADJ → DJ → HC Judge (via promotion or HC collegium). Pay Level 11/12 (₹77,840-1L) entry; District Judge Level 14 ₹1.4L.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 11-14 LPA / Mid (DJ): 18-30 LPA / Senior (HC Judge): 30-45 LPA + benefits. Note: Govt accommodation, vehicle, staff included. Source: 7th Pay, SC/HC scales.

sub_paths.name: Corporate Law (M&A, Banking & Finance)
sub_paths.description: Specialization in mergers/acquisitions, private equity, banking, capital markets — the highest-paying law firm specialty in India.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: Indirect; tier-1 firm route requires NLU placement
sub_paths.entry_route: Degree → tier-1 firm via campus placement
sub_paths.qualification: BA LLB / BBA LLB; CS/CA addl. qualification helps
sub_paths.duration: Built over 5 yr law degree + 5-7 yr firm experience
scholarships: firm-funded LLM sponsorships for top performers
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: LLM at Harvard, NYU, Columbia (₹50-80L) for M&A/Finance specialty; secondment to Singapore/London/NY tier-1 firm offices.
sub_paths.day_in_life: 60-80 hr weeks during deals; due diligence, contract drafting, closing logistics. High-stress but high-pay.
sub_paths.growth_path: A0 → SA → PA → Counsel → Partner; equity partner ₹1-5 Cr+. Some pivot to PE funds, investment banking, or in-house GC.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 15-22 LPA / Mid (5-7 yr SA/PA): 30-60 LPA / Senior (Partner 10-15 yr): 80 LPA-5 Cr. Note: Big-deal years bring large performance bonuses. Source: Legally India, Law Drishti 2025-26.

sub_paths.name: Intellectual Property (IP) Law
sub_paths.description: Patents, trademarks, copyrights, designs, trade secrets — niche specialty often combining law + science/tech background.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: Indirect; need LLB; STEM background advantageous for patents
sub_paths.qualification: BA/BBA LLB; B.Tech + LLB combo prized for patent work
sub_paths.duration: 5-yr LLB or 3-yr LLB + Patent Agent exam
sub_paths.entrance_exam: CLAT/AILET + Patent Agent Examination (for patent prosecution)
sub_paths.govt_fees: Same as LLB; Patent Agent exam ₹1,600-3,200
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: LLM in IP — Cambridge, Munich Max Planck, NYU IP, Berkeley (₹40-70L). Patent attorney route in USA via USPTO bar; bigger pay, but very long path.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Patent drafting, prosecution, opposition; trademark registration, infringement suits. Better work-life balance than M&A — typically 9-7.
sub_paths.growth_path: A0 → SA → PA → Partner. IP boutique partners (Anand & Anand, Remfry) earn ₹50L-1.5 Cr. In-house IP roles at pharma, tech MNCs paying ₹15-30 LPA.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 4-10 LPA (tier-1 IP firms 6-9L; tier-2 4-6L) / Mid: 12-25 LPA / Senior (Partner): 25-80 LPA+. Note: IP grows slower than M&A but better quality of life. Source: Legally India IP salary thread.

sub_paths.name: Tax Law (Direct + Indirect / GST)
sub_paths.description: Direct tax (income tax, corporate tax) and indirect tax (GST, customs, excise) advisory, litigation, planning.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: Indirect; need LLB; CA / CS combination strongly advantageous
sub_paths.entry_route: Degree → Tax law firm or Big 4 tax practice
sub_paths.duration: 5-yr LLB or 3-yr LLB; CA/CS adds 3-4 years
sub_paths.entrance_exam: CLAT/AILET; CA Foundation/Inter for CA route
top_institutions: Big 4 Tax practice — Deloitte, EY, KPMG, PwC (private)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: LLM in International Tax at NYU, Leiden Netherlands (specialist), Vienna IBFD. Big 4 secondments to UAE, Singapore.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Mix of advisory drafting, tribunal/HC tax appearances, GST consulting. Less crunch than M&A; quarter-end and budget-time peaks.
sub_paths.growth_path: Tax Associate → Senior → Manager → Director → Partner. Big 4 tax partner ₹80L-2.5 Cr. Specialist law firm partner similar.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 8-14 LPA (Tier-2 cities 10-12L; Mumbai/Delhi 14L) / Mid: 18-35 LPA / Senior (Partner): 50 LPA-2 Cr. Note: CA + LLB combo commands premium. Source: Legally India, Law Drishti.

sub_paths.name: International Arbitration
sub_paths.description: Cross-border commercial dispute resolution — ICC, SIAC, LCIA, ICSID seats. High-stakes, high-pay specialty.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: Indirect; need LLB; LLM in international law nearly mandatory
sub_paths.entry_route: Degree → tier-1 firm arbitration team or international arb practice
sub_paths.qualification: BA LLB + LLM (Int'l Arbitration / Int'l Commercial Law)
sub_paths.govt_fees: Indian LLB+LLM fees as per NLU
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Career itself is global — Singapore, London, Paris, Geneva are major arbitration hubs. India arb hubs growing (MCIA Mumbai, ICA Delhi).
sub_paths.day_in_life: Drafting submissions, oral arguments at arbitral tribunals, witness prep, evidence analysis. Travel-intensive; hearings often overseas.
sub_paths.growth_path: Associate → Senior → Counsel → Partner. Sitting arbitrator route at SIAC/ICC pays USD 1.5-3K/day for ad-hoc panels.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 12-20 LPA (tier-1 firm arb team) / Mid: 30-60 LPA / Senior (Partner / Counsel): 75 LPA-3 Cr+. Note: Independent arbitration counsel + arbitrator income highly variable. Source: GAR India, Legally India.

sub_paths.name: Environmental & Public Interest Law
sub_paths.description: Environmental compliance, climate litigation, public interest litigation, NGT practice, policy advocacy.
sub_paths.entry_route: Degree → NGO / boutique env-law firm / academic
sub_paths.qualification: BA LLB; LLM Environmental Law preferred
sub_paths.govt_fees: Same NLU LLB fees; LLM in env at TERI Univ ₹2-4L
top_institutions: WWF India - Centre for Conservation Education (NGO)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: LLM in Environmental Law at Yale F&ES, NYU, SOAS London, Stanford. UN Environmental Program internships, IPCC tracks.
sub_paths.day_in_life: NGT cases, EIA challenges, policy briefs, stakeholder consultations. Slower-paced than corporate; ideologically driven for many.
sub_paths.growth_path: Junior associate at boutique → Senior → Independent practitioner / NGO Director / Academic. Limited tier-1 firm pipeline; mid-pay sector.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 4-9 LPA / Mid: 8-18 LPA / Senior: 15-40 LPA. Note: NGO sector lower (3-7L); private env consulting (ERM, Climate Policy Initiative) 8-15L; senior counsel + policy advocacy higher. Source: Vidhi, Legally India.

sub_paths.name: Sports & Entertainment / Media Law
sub_paths.description: Sports contracts, IPL/cricket regulation, entertainment IP, OTT/media rights, talent agency representation.
sub_paths.entry_route: Degree → boutique sports/entertainment firm or in-house at media co
top_institutions: In-house at Star Sports, Disney+ Hotstar, Sony Pictures (private)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: LLM in Sports Law at Manchester, Tilburg Netherlands; Entertainment Law at UCLA, Loyola LA, Columbia Law.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Player/talent contract drafting, IP licensing for media rights, regulatory compliance for OTT, dispute resolution at arbitration tribunals (BCCI, AIFF).
sub_paths.growth_path: Specialty practice still small in India; partner-track at boutique sports firms ₹50L-1.5 Cr. In-house at OTT/sports leagues ₹15-40L mid-career.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 6-12 LPA / Mid: 15-30 LPA / Senior: 30-80 LPA. Note: Indian Sports Law market rapidly growing post-IPL/ISL; high-end limited but growing. Source: Krida Legal disclosures, GAR.

sub_paths.name: Company Secretary (CS) — Law Adjacent
sub_paths.description: ICSI Company Secretary qualification — corporate compliance, governance, board secretarial, SEBI/MCA regulatory work.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: 12th pass to start CSEET (CS Executive Entrance); 50% common cutoff
sub_paths.entrance_exam: ICSI CSEET (4 times/year); CS Executive; CS Professional
top_institutions: Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI, statutory)
ICSI Centres of Excellence (Delhi, Mumbai, Hyderabad, govt)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: ICSA UK (Chartered Governance Institute) recognized in UK, Singapore, Australia, Hong Kong. Strong corporate-secretary roles in MNCs abroad.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Board meetings, compliance filings (MCA-21, ROC, SEBI), legal-secretarial drafting, due diligence support. White-collar 9-6 mostly.
sub_paths.growth_path: CS Trainee → Asst Co Secy → Co Secy → Senior CS → CS + GC role. CS + LLB combo highly valued for in-house counsel/Board roles.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 4-9 LPA / Mid: 10-25 LPA / Senior (CS at listed co): 25-80 LPA. Note: CS at large listed companies ₹30-50L; CS + LLB combo at MNC GC role ₹50L-1Cr. Source: ICSI placement, AmbitionBox.

data_confidence_notes: Tier-1 law firm A0 salaries verified via Law Drishti 2025 and Legally India crowdsourced 2025-26 data — figures match across multiple independent sources.
IP law firm salaries vary widely by team (patent prosecution vs trademark vs litigation); ₹4-10L fresher band reflects this spread.
Judicial Services pay structure verified against latest Supreme Court directives (Justice Shetty Commission revisions).
International Arbitration salaries flagged 'medium' confidence — Indian career arc data is sparse; figures projected from London/Singapore market with India discount.
Sports & Entertainment Law flagged 'low' confidence — small market in India, salary data is mostly anecdotal; firm-by-firm variation is enormous.
